assertions.equality_rule: exact stable total bytes; used and available bytes within bracketed reference values; stable all-null reference capacity requires non-observed state with null bytes; ineligible mounts explicitly not_requested with null values

assertions.eligibility: route-netlink address dump succeeds and iproute2 exposes complete lifetimes for each stable address

assertions.equality_rule: exact IPv4 and IPv6 rule tuple including goto jump priority and interface names; other netlink families remain reported but are outside these two iproute2 reference commands; unknown reference fields, candidate attributes, or flag bits leave the assertion partial
